description: This file defines a class implementing a CSRF defense strategy that effectively disables CSRF protection by returning null tokens and default values, indicating no CSRF defense is active.

classes.name: NoCsrfDefenseStrategy
classes.description: A class implementing ICsrfDefenseStrategy that disables CSRF protection measures by returning default or null values for related methods.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no CSRF token is generated.

methods.name: maxSubFolderInRequestUrlForTokenMapLookup
methods.description: Returns 0, indicating no subfolder depth consideration for token lookup.

methods.name: modifySecurityCsrfToken
methods.description: Always returns false, meaning it does not modify or validate CSRF tokens.

methods.name: keepTokenAfterUse
methods.description: Returns false, indicating tokens are not kept after use.

methods.name: invalidTokenResponse
methods.description: Empty implementation, does not handle invalid token responses.
